attachments.name: medical_plan.txt
attachments.text:
Medical cover for the St. Anne's Charity Run 7K, Saturday 28 August 2027

From Owen Cartwright, Event Secretary, St. Anne's Parish Fun Run Committee

The race is a 7K with 180 runners and starts at 10:00. We expect a crew from Halden Medical Transport on the day, though we have nothing in writing yet.

First aid
We'll have 3 first aid posts, at the start, the finish and halfway, with 6 trained first aiders between them, so nobody on the course is more than about a kilometre and a half from help. We also have two first aiders on bikes, carrying defibrillators.

Heat, cold and water
We always tell runners to dress sensibly for the weather and to keep drinking, and it's all in the email we send them the week before. We'll be watching the forecast, and people here are used to all sorts of weather.

Runners get an email in race week telling them to dress for the weather and to keep a phone with them if they can. Most have run with us before. The list of entrants includes an emergency contact for each runner, which is kept at the start.

If someone needs hospital
If someone needed the hospital we'd dial 911 and the paramedics would take it from there. They know what they're doing far better than we do, and the city's service is very good.

Staying in touch
We'll all have our phones, and I'll send a list of numbers round the team the week before. The signal is usually fine around there.

Who's responsible
Our medical lead is Ruth Abernathy, a registered paramedic, who'll be there from an hour before the start until the last runner is in and has the final word on pulling any runner out.
